$comment: The render context for templates/display-manager/config.toml.j2 (greetd). TWO names — the greeter user in `{{ }}` and the greeter type as an `{% if %}` condition. A `{{ }}`-only count reports 1 and misses the branch variable; `make validate-templates` reads both expression forms.
title: display-manager/config.toml.j2 — render context
description: The two values the greetd config reads: which greeter runs, and the user it runs as.

display_manager_greeter_type.description: Selects the [default_session] command: regreet inside cage, or tuigreet with the hypr-session launcher. Read as an `{% if %}` condition — required even though it never appears in a `{{ }}` interpolation.

display_manager_greeter_user.description: The system user the greeter session runs as (the greetd `user` field).

x-render-contract.no_default_on_required: No `default(` fallback on either name. An unset greeter type must fail the render, not silently choose a greeter the target has no package for.
x-render-contract.assets_scope: The greetd/regreet/cage package lists live in the installer (spine AD-9); this template selects among already-installed greeters.
